headline: Turn-12 cap: Graveyard Shift leads 40 to 16 and is lethal next turn

result.summary: The Twelfth Doctor was eliminated on turn 8 and Osgir on turn 10. At the horizon Bartolomé is at 40 behind a lifelink army; Sygg is at 16 and losing the race.

seats.name: Captain of the Dawnsire
seats.plan: put **Dawnsire, Sunstar Dreadnought** onto the battlefield, station it, and redirect damage into opponents
